results.title: Me ya sa ake kai wa tarukan jam’iyyun hamayya hari a Najeriya?
results.content: Gabanin zaɓen Najeriya na 2027, ana samun yanayi na rashin tabbas inda ake kai wa jam'iyyun adawa hari a lokacin yaƙin neman zaɓe.

results.title: Real Madrid da PSG na hamayya kan Suzuki, Bayern na son tsawaita zaman Olise
results.content: PSG da Real Madrid na nuna sha'awar ɗaukar golan Aston Villa, Zion Suzuki, yayin da Bayern Munich ke shirin tsawaita kwangilar ɗan wasan gefe na Faransa, Michael Olise.

results.title: Fa'az: Sabon makami mai linzami na zamani da Pakistan ta ƙera

results.title: Yadda Iran ta fara aikin sake gina cibiyoyin makamanta da aka lalata

results.title: Waɗanne abubuwa ne a cikin ɗakin Ka'abah?

results.title: Su wane ne za su ci gajiyar tallafin N50,000 na gwamnatin Najeriya?
results.content: Ministan harkokin jin ƙai Bernard Doro ya bayyana cewa masu amfana ba sa buƙatar neman shiga shirin, biyan wani kuɗi, ko yin rajista ta hannun wasu wakilai domin samun damar cin gajiyar shirin.

results.title: Me sakamakon zaɓen Amurka ke nufi ga ƙasashen duniya?
results.content: Jam'iyyar Democrat ta karɓe ikon majalisar dokokin Amurka, inda za ta ci gaba da tafiyar da majalisar har zuwa ƙarshen wa'adin shugabancin Donald Trump. Sakamakon zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adin ya kawo babban sauyi a fagen siyasar Amurka. BBC ta yi bayani kan abin da sakamakon zaɓen ke nufi ga sauran ƙasashen duniya, tun daga yaƙe-yaƙen Ukraine da na Gabas ta Tsakiya zuwa dangantakar kasuwanci tsakanin Amurka da China.

results.title: Lokutan da Shugaba Tinubu ya nemi rancen ƙasashen waje
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Ahmed Tinubu ya aike da buƙata a hukumance zuwa Majalisar dokoki domin neman amincewa ya karɓo rance daga ƙasashen waje da ya kai dala biliyan 7.7, kwatankwacin naira triliyan 10.79 don taimakawa wajen cike giɓin kasafin kuɗin 2026 na naira triliyan 31.4.

results.title: Matasa 'yan Afirka da suka lashe zaɓen Amurka
results.content: A lokacin yaƙin neman zaɓensa, El-Sayed ya yi amfani da kafafen sada zumunta sosai wajen isa ga masu zaɓe, musamman matasa. A bidiyoyinsa da yake wallafawa a dandalin TikTok, ana ganinsa yana magana kai tsaye da matasan Gen Z, inda yake amfani da barkwanci da matasan ke so, har ma da sanya mundayen abota a hannunsa.

results.title: Su wane ne jagororin yaƙin neman zaɓen Tinubu, Atiku da Obi?
results.content: Yayin da aka kaɗa gangamin siyasa a Najeriya gabanin babban zaɓen Najeriya na 2027, jam'iyyun siyasa daban-daban sun duƙufa wajen samun goyon bayan jama'a.

results.title: Tarihi huɗu da aka kafa a zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adin Amurka
results.content: Jam'iyyar Republican ta Shugaba Trump ta gamu da babban koma baya inda ta sha gagarumin kaye a zaɓukan tsakiyar wa'adi a ƙasar ta Amurka. Kafin wannan zaɓen dai jam'iyyar Republican ce ke da rinjaye a duka majalisun biyu. Kumi tuni masu nazarin siyasar ƙasar suka yi hasashen Demokrats za ta ƙwace iko da majalisar wakilai, amma ba a yi zaton za ta ƙwace iko a majalisar dattawa ba.

results.title: Kotu ta soke takarar Atiku Abubakar na jam'iyyar ADC
results.content: Babbar kotun tarayya da ke Abuja ta rushe shugabancin ADC tsagin Sanata David Mark.

results.title: Abu huɗu da za a iya binciken Trump a kai bayan rasa rinjaye a Majalisa
results.content: Ƴan jam'iyyar Democrat na da ƙudurin ganin sun binciki wasu daga cikin jami'an gwamnatin Trump har ma da shi kansa.

results.title: Wane ne Abdul El-Sayed Musulmi na farko da ya zama sanata a Amurka?
results.content: El-Sayed, wanda likita ne wanda bai taa rike mukamin siyasa ba na a tsakiyar wani yakin neman zabe wanda ya haifar da rarrabuwar kawuna saboda bambancin launin fata.

results.title: Yaƙin Iran ne dalilin mummunar asara da muka yi a zaɓen rabin wa'adi - Trump
results.content: Wannan shafi ne da ke kawo muku abubuwan da ke faruwa a Najeriya da sauran sassan duniya na ranar Laraba 4 ga watan Nuwamba, 2026.

results.title: Lalurar da ke hana mutum barcin sama da awa huɗu a rana
results.content: Wasu na buƙatar sa'o'i bakwai zuwa tara na barci, amma duk da haka akwai wasu mutane da suke kasancewa cikin ƙoshin lafiya ko da ba sa samun isasshen barci.

results.title: Abubuwa 6 da za su iya haramta maka yin zaɓe a Najeriya
results.content: Yayin da babban zaɓen Najeriya na 2027 ke ƙara karatowa, masu kaɗa kuri'a na ta ribibi wajen ganin sun karɓi katunan zaɓensu domin samun damar zaɓar ɗan takarar da suke so.

results.title: Fitattun ƴan Najeriya da suka taɓa shiga ɗakin Ka'aba
results.content: Baya ga Tinubu, waɗanne mashahuran ƴan Najeriya ne suka samu damar shiga ɗakin na Ka'aba?
